Author: Alok Kumar Verma
Bench: Alok Kumar Verma
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders or

 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order
S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  10.06.2024 AO No.225 of 2024  Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

The proposed Appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed by the insurer challenging the Award dated 01.04.2024, passed by learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal/ IInd Additional District Judge, Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar in Motor Accident Claim Petition No.320 of 2019, by which, the learned Tribunal has awarded a total sum of Rs.19,59,406/- as a compensation along with an interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till its actual payment.
2.

entities.text: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal/ IInd Additional District Judge, Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Motor Accident Claim Petition No.320 of 2019
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Mr. D.C.S. Rawat, learned counsel for the proposed appellant.
Issue notice to the respondent nos.1 to 4, respondent no.6 and respondent no.7.
Steps to be taken within a week.
Heard on the Stay Application (IA No.01 of 2024).

7. Mr. D.C.S. Rawat, Advocate, has sought six weeks' time from today to deposit Rs.19,00,000/-
(Rupees Nineteen Lakh) before the Tribunal concerned.
8. Subject to depositing Rs. 19,00,000/- (Rupees Nineteen Lakh), as prayed, the effect and operation of the impugned Award dated 01.04.2024 are stayed till further order.
9. The said amount shall be deposited in the fixed deposit scheme of a nationalized bank.
10. The Stay Application (IA No.01 of 2024) stands disposed of accordingly.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 10.06.2024 Pant/
